crossRefs.note: Why do you go about so much to change your ways? You will be ashamed of Egypt also, as you were ashamed of Assyria.
But the shameful thing has devoured the labor of our fathers from our youth, their flocks and their herds, their sons…
Let us lie down in our shame, and let our confusion cover us; for we have sinned against Yahweh our God, we and our…
Men don’t despise a thief if he steals to satisfy himself when he is hungry;
but if he is found, he shall restore seven times. He shall give all the wealth of his house.
For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which you have desired, and you shall be confounded for the gardens that you have…
What fruit then did you have at that time in the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is…
because of all the evil of the children of Israel and of the children of Judah, which they have done to provoke me to…
Since the days of our fathers we have been exceedingly guilty to this day; and for our iniquities we, our kings, and…
Now therefore, our God, the great, the mighty, and the awesome God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness, don’t let…
We haven’t listened to your servants the prophets, who spoke in your name to our kings, our princes, and our fathers…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: As the thief is ashamed when he is found, so the house of Israel is ashamed: they, their kings, their princes, their priests, and their prophets,
translations.bsb: As the thief is ashamed when he is caught, so the house of Israel is disgraced. They, their kings, their officials, their priests, and their prophets
